source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps slave and apostle identities and their stated purpose.
key_decisions.before: Paul, a slave of God and apostle of Jesus Christ, for the trust of God’s chosen people and the knowledge of the truth that accords with godliness,
key_decisions.after: Paul, a slave of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, for the faith of God's chosen people and their knowledge of the truth that accords with godliness,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, for the sake of the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth, which accords with godliness,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves male marital idiom and the ambiguous believing/faithful description.
key_decisions.before: An elder must be above accusation, faithful to one spouse, with believing children who are not accused of reckless living or rebellion.
key_decisions.after: An elder must be beyond accusation, a one-woman man, with faithful children not accused of wild living or rebellion.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: if anyone is above reproach, the husband of one wife, and his children are believers and not open to the charge of debauchery or insubordination.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps stewardship and all five prohibitions.
key_decisions.before: For an overseer, as God’s steward, must be above accusation—not arrogant, quick-tempered, addicted to wine, violent, or greedy for dishonest gain,
key_decisions.after: For an overseer, as God's steward, must be beyond accusation—not self-willed, quick-tempered, addicted to wine, violent or greedy for dishonest gain,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For an overseer, as God’s steward, must be above reproach. He must not be arrogant or quick-tempered or a drunkard or violent or greedy for gain,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains three descriptions and specified subgroup.
key_decisions.before: For there are many rebellious people, empty talkers, and deceivers, especially those from the circumcision group.
key_decisions.after: For there are many rebellious people, empty talkers and deceivers, especially those from the circumcision group.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For there are many who are insubordinate, empty talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision party.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps forceful response, household harm and financial motive.
key_decisions.before: They must be silenced because they are overturning whole households by teaching what they should not for shameful gain.
key_decisions.after: They must be silenced, because they overturn whole households by teaching what they should not for shameful gain.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: They must be silenced, since they are upsetting whole households by teaching for shameful gain what they ought not to teach.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the quoted ethnic insult, speaker relation and animal/bodily rhetoric.
key_decisions.before: One of their own prophets said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”
key_decisions.after: One of their own, a prophet of theirs, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy bellies.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: One of the Cretans, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the letter's endorsement, severity and corrective aim.
key_decisions.before: This testimony is true. Therefore correct them sharply so that they may become sound in the trust,
key_decisions.after: This testimony is true. Therefore, rebuke them sharply so that they may become sound in the faith,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the specific polemical labels without generalizing beyond the opponents.
key_decisions.before: not paying attention to Jewish myths and commands of people who turn away from the truth.
key_decisions.after: not paying attention to Jewish myths and commands of people who turn away from the truth.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: not devoting themselves to Jewish myths and the commands of people who turn away from the truth.
